past participle of kḷp; nominative singular masculine with final visarga represented in sandhi
manner adverb indicating the corresponding mode of conformity
compound of tad and anuvartana; denotes following in accordance with the contrived designation

items.question: How does conformity proceed when a designation is merely contrived for conventional usage?
premises: A designation is merely contrived for conventional usage.
Such a designation may be contrived in one way or another.
Conformity follows the manner in which that designation is contrived.
items.inference: Conformity to conventional usage proceeds according to the specific manner of the contrived designation.
uncertainties: The exact antecedent of tenaiva is contextually inferred from the preceding verses' discussion of saṃjñā.
items.plain_english: Therefore, whether contrived in this way or that, conformity to it follows accordingly.
